setup.title: Set up SocialGrid
setup.noSupabaseText: Connect Supabase to this Vercel project (Vercel → your project → Storage → Supabase), then redeploy and reload this page.
setup.intro: This creates the database tables, the founder logins and (optionally) two sample clients. It can only be done once.
setup.introSchemaReady: The database is ready. Create the founder logins below. This can only be done once.
setup.name: Name
setup.samples: Add 2 sample clients for demos (a salon and a restaurant)

reset.title: Reset a password
reset.intro: For the SocialGrid team. Set a new password for any login (founder or client email) without using email.
reset.done: Password changed. You can log in with the new password now.
reset.disabledText: To switch it on, the Vercel project owner sets a recovery code once:
reset.disabledStep1: Vercel → socialgrid project → Settings → Environment Variables.
reset.disabledStep2: Add a variable named RECOVERY_CODE with a long secret phrase you choose (at least 12 characters), for Production.
reset.disabledStep3: Redeploy the project, then come back here and enter that phrase as the recovery code.
